# Research Duties
The laboratory exists to turn unknown materials into Company property. Every recorded finding earns the site money.
## Equipment The Company's research equipment is ordered through the corporate ASRS: - The [bold]XRF scanner[/bold] analyses unknown samples. - The [bold]research data terminal[/bold] stores reports, tracks the laboratory's research points and offers chemical contracts. - The [bold]synthesis simulator[/bold] tests new compounds before they are produced.
Full operating instructions are in the research section of the guidebook.
## The Research Licence - All Company research on a colony depends on the colony's research licence. While it is revoked, research earns the Company nothing. - Staff may not give the colony any reason to revoke the licence. - Any threat to the licence must be reported to the Lead Researcher immediately.
## Records - All work must be recorded. Unrecorded results are not accepted. - Reports are to be saved to the research data terminal, never to personal notes. - Every sample must be labelled with its contents, its source and who handled it. - Samples, reports and data may not leave the laboratory without the Lead Researcher's approval.
## Contracts - Chemical contracts are accepted at the research data terminal. - Staff must clear a contract with the Lead Researcher before accepting it. - Accepted contracts are to be delivered on time.
